response.sql: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS avg_entry_count FROM race_counts) SELECT rc.raceId, rc.country, rc.total_points, rc.entry_count, rc.entry_count - ra.avg_entry_count AS above_average FROM race_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rc.entry_count > ra.avg_entry_count ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
